proves.claim: timelineOf turns a mark event with edge start and a later one with edge end into smoke start and end rows at their detail.at times, with the span counted as landing.

stats.timeline.mark-rows.why: A smoke started and ended by a mark event had no row, so its time read as unaccounted.

proves.claim: a mark event whose stage is not in TIMELINE_STAGES adds no row and does not throw.

stats.timeline.mark-unknown-stage.why: A new or misspelled stage in a mark must not break the timeline.
